about_the_game:
Spread your wings! Take the dive! Become a bird!!

*Hayatsubasa* is a revolutionary VR flight game that lets you truly become a bird!

Experience intuitive controls as you perform a variety of actions: flap your arms to accelerate, lower one arm to turn, raise both arms for a claw attack, and pull them back to fold your wings for a thrilling free-fall acceleration.

Come on, spread your wings and dive into this paradise!

#### **For "About This Game" field:**

*Hayatsubasa* is a VR flight action game that pursues the ultimate "become a bird" experience using an HMD and controllers.

Its greatest feature is the intuitive controls that make you feel like a real bird. Flap your arms to accelerate, lower one arm to turn, and pull your arms back to fold your wings and free-fall. You can perform a wide range of actions just by moving your body.

In **Sightseeing Flight Mode**, you can freely explore the sky, making it a safe and enjoyable experience even for VR beginners. Take a relaxing stroll through the air as you fly around a beautiful, nature-rich island, popping balloons floating in the sky or searching for hidden golden balloons.

For those seeking thrills and speed, **Race Mode** is for you. Utilize technical maneuvers like boosts and free-falls to compete against rivals and your own best times. The tension of slipping through narrow spaces and the exhilaration of diving across the finish line are truly exceptional.

Why not experience a new world from a bird's-eye view and make your dream of flying come true in *Hayatsubasa*?
